notes.title: 5 New Upgrades & Snail Art
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Hope you've been enjoying the colorful chaos in Turf Wars: A Snail Escape! I come with some good news – five new upgrades have sprouted in the garden, ready to take your snail adventures to the next level. 

[b]💥 Damage Explosion
[/b]When you take a hit, at least make it count! With Damage Explosion, create massive friendly explosions whenever you take damage

[b]🎨 Start Turf
[/b]Claim your territory from the get-go! Start with more yellow area already claimed when entering a new zone.

[b]🌈 Converting Splatana
[/b]Why pop bullets when you can claim them? Converting Splatana changes bullets into your color instead of popping them

[b]💨 Smokey Bullets
[/b]Popped bullets leave a smelly gas that hurts enemies and converts enemy bullets. Can be added to the Slime Gun, Jellyblaster & Goo Cannon

[b]👅Bad Breath
[/b]Doesn't sound that good, I know! Your Frog Tongue leaves a nasty smell whenever you use it, which damage enemies and converts bullets into yours.

[h2]Snail Art Showcase
[/h2]And now, something cool to look at! Our little snail guy has been modelling. Check out InterndotGif's super-stylish version of our snail hero sweating as he evades those angry bees. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mx20nUlToEU]Watch the full video here and check out his channel[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536035/95a28b6fda50b53de92b3378372cc805726571bc.jpg[/img]

Su Đờn has conjured an absolutely insane image of how a fully upgraded snail hero looks like. I absolutly love it! [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gTDm7MmFEW4]Check out Su Đờn's video here[/url], I laughed a lot even though I don't speak a word Vietnamese

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536035/813726c33980ff5eba53e3eeb9630c7cfb774737.jpg[/img]

Lastly I wanted to share who the artist was who created the awesome cover art for the game. His name is Rajieskecchi and you can check out more of his great work [url=https://www.artstation.com/rajieskecchi]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536035/1502dd581b7eba9661f71a35e277fe2c2a876354.png[/img]

You got versions of our little snail guy you want to share? I would love to see it!

Snail Hugs,
Andreas Werdin 🐌

notes.title: New Boss Has Arrived
notes.content:
Hey Snail Squad,

Hold onto your shells because a new era has dawned in the garden – Mecha-Queen has arrived! 🤖👑 Armed with a laser sword on her left hook and the ability to shoot laser beams from her right, she's here to bring a whole new level of electrifying chaos to the garden!

[b]Meet Mecha-Queen[/b]
🔵 Laser Sword: Watch out for her swift strikes with a laser sword attached to her left hook.
🔴 Laser Beams: Dodge the laser beams she unleashes from her right hook – precision is key!
⚡ Electric Minions: She's not alone! Mecha-Queen can launch electric minions that create laser beams from their antennae, adding a layer of strategic madness to the battlefield.

[b]Hunt for Mecha-Queen
[/b]Finding Mecha-Queen is not as hard as you think, so I thought I could explain how it works. Bosses spawn randomly once you've conquered the main area boss. But to keep it more fun with added bosses, a lower weighting is calculated for the boss you've beaten the most.

For example:

You've conquered The Queen & The Hive 3 times.
The Swarm has been defeated once.
Mecha-Queen? Yet to face her.
Now, when a boss is randomly selected, The Swarm and Mecha-Queen each have a 44% chance, while The Queen & The Hive is at 12%. It's a dynamic system that keeps you on your toes and makes it finding new bosses easier!

Ready to face the electrifying challenge? Dive into the garden, dodge those lasers, and let the Mecha-Queen showdown begin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536035/d955a201b23a1fb06cd547fc695ca8cd2e40e693.png[/img]

Snail Hugs,
Andreas Werdin 🐌

notes.title: Turf Wars Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey Snail Squad,

I hope you've been enjoying the slimy adventures in Turf Wars: A Snail Escape for the past week! A massive thank you to everyone who's been part of this cool journey so far. 🐌

But get ready, cause the garden escape is about to get even more exciting – introducing the Turf Wars Roadmap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42536035/9774e57d60cd5a065cecbd04e2468146be914b29.png[/img]

[b]New Boss - Mecha-Queen
[/b]Get ready to face the electrifying Mecha-Queen! She's armed with lasers, a deadly short-range attack, and electric minions. Can you outsmart her and conquer the lawn? Mecha-Queen arrives this Sunday – don't miss the showdown! ⚡

[b]5 New Upgrades
[/b]The journey isn't complete without some more upgrades! I've got a list of many thrilling upgrades to add, and the top 5 upgrades will be added in the next DLC. What enhancements do you want to see? Let me know! 🛠️

[b]New Boss - Untitled Pond Boss
[/b]The murky waters won't be the same – a new, big boss is stepping onto the waterlilies! Get ready for an epic battle across the pond🌊

[b]2 New Weapons
[/b]Expand your arsenal with two new weapons! You got any crazy ideas of what we should add? I'm thinking of a frog deployer. Let’s see what we decide to add 🐸

[b]New Boss - Untitled Wall Boss
[/b]Tired of birds always chasing you around? Brace yourselves for a new big baddie at the top of the wall! Who it will be, and what havoc they will wreak we will announce in 2024? 🧱

[b]New Game Mode
[/b]This one's a biggie! Depending on your interest, a new game mode is on the horizon. What do you think is missing? Local Co-op, Local Battle mode, Boss rush, or an Endless survival mode? Your input matters! 🎮

I'll keep you in the loop as more updates roll in. Snail on!

/Andreas Werdin

notes.title: "Turf Wars: A Snail Escape" is launched
notes.content:
Hey Snail Squad,

I'm absolutely thrilled to announce that the wait is over – Turf Wars: A Snail Escape is officially available on Steam, and I can't wait for you to dive into this slimy adventure right now!

[b]🐌 Why Turf Wars?
[/b]Imagine a brave snail, a garden teeming with challenges, and bugs of all shapes and sizes standing in your way. It's a vibrant journey filled with slime, epic battles, and a whole lot of fun – and it's ready for you to play!

[b]🌍 Bonjour, Hola, Ciao, Guten Tag, Olá!
[/b]Exciting news – Turf Wars speaks six languages now! English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Portuguese – because snails are universal, and so should be the fun! Immerse yourself in the game in the language that feels like home.

[b]🌟 Meet The Swarm – The New Boss in Town!
[/b]Hidden deep in the grass is a surprise waiting for you – The Swarm! Brace yourselves for a wild ride as you face off against this new boss. It's a challenge, but I know you've got what it takes!

[b]🚀 Roadmap Unveiling Soon!
[/b]What's next, you ask? Later this week, I'm unveiling the roadmap for future updates. And it will be open to your input. Your feedback is like golden slime – precious and essential. Tell me what you love and what we can improve!

[b]🎉 Heartfelt Thanks
[/b]A massive THANK YOU for your incredible support. All that have playtested, given feedback and in any way helped out with the game. Your enthusiasm has fueled this snail-powered adventure, and I'm beyond grateful. Turf Wars wouldn't be the same without each and every one of you.

[b]🐌 Play Now!
[/b]Don't wait – jump into Turf Wars: A Snail Escape and start your snail-tastic journey now. Gather your friends, spread the word, and let's make this launch a lot of fun!

Thank you for being part of this incredible adventure. Can't wait to see you in the garden!

Snail Hugs,
Andreas Werdin

notes.title: Release Date Announced
notes.content:
Hey there slugs!

We're thrilled to announce the release of Turf Wars - A Snail Escape. Mark your calendars for November 30th, 2023. Dive into a world where snails aren't just slow-moving garden creatures, but agile slime-shooting warriors!🐌

All of the late nights, the brainstorming, the countless play-tests... it's all been for this moment. And we can't wait for you to experience the magic at the unbeatable price of $5.99 USD (or equivalent in your currency).

Here is some facts on the launch version on the game
[list]
[*] Supported languages: English, but it's gameplay focus game so don't worry if it isnt your preferred language
[*] Supported controllers: You can use both Keyboard/Mouse and any controller you might have.
[*] Number of players: It's a single player experience only
[*] Expected length: It's a roguelike so it all depends on you. There will be 5 areas with 5 unique bosses, 47 different enemies and 21 different items that can be upgrades in many ways. You can also replay the game on hard and ultra mode once you have beaten the game once. 
[*] I'm sure I missed some important info, so feel free to drop me a comment below with any question you might have
[/list]
From all of us at North Lake Games, thank you for being on this journey with us. Let's paint the world yellow! 💛

Stay slimy!
Andreas Werdin

This is the first live stream of 2 during Steam Next Fest June 2023

[h3]What is Turf Wars: A Snail Escape?[/h3]
This is an action roguelike twin-stick shooter, where the focus is on movement and controlling the battleground using your slime abilities. Stay on your turf at all time while the slimy enemies try to cover you in enemy slime. The full game will include 5 areas with unique enemies, bosses and slime types and is aimed to launch in the second half of 2023.

notes.title: May 2023 Update
notes.content:
New trailer is out, which I spent way to much time working on. What do you think? I have also done lots of playtesting and some nice improvements to the game to prepare for the upcoming Steam Next Fest, which is the next big milestone I'm aiming for. I have also spent a lot of time with accessibility options since I want everyone to be able to play the game the way they want to. If you want you can check out the release notes below:

[h2]Demo Release notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 4 difficulty settings (easy, normal and 2 harder modes that unlock if finishing the game on previous difficulty). The different difficulties change player health, number of enemies per level and boss health.
[*] Holding fire buttons will fire weapon when reloaded (to avoid having to spam buttons)
[*] Autofire accessibility option - Makes your primary always fire when reloaded without player input required
[*] Possible to skip the gem box opening animation by pressing shoot-button
[*] Color rewards UX changes
[*] Changed so you have to click a button to interact with the Snail NPCs (instead of walking into them)
[*] Boss “The Queen and the Hive” added new attack and balancing to avoid spamming attacks
[*] New upgrade: Crossed Explosions - Makes Jelly Bomb, Slime Mines or Home Pillar explode in a large cross pattern
[*] New upgrade: Baseball Bat - Makes Splat Blade hit a small slime ball each swing
[*] New upgrade: Splat Yourself - Passive power upgrade that lets you spread splat around you every couple of seconds
[/list]

[h2]Balancing changes[/h2]
This is where I need your feedback the most. I'm completely blind to the difficulty, so please let me know if you feel the game is too easy or too hard, and also what gaming experience you have. This is the changes I have done based on recent playtests:
[list]
[*] Bee enemies movement speed increased
[*] Bee enemies fire delay decreased
[*] All primary weapons reload speed decreased
[*] Time between enemy respawns decreased
[*] 1 more bee-enemy spawn each area on normal and easy difficulty
[*] Unlocked Hard & Ultra difficulty from the start in demo build
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some audiobugs with music not turning off correctly
[*] Fixed bug that made it possible to trigger double amount of enemies in next area
[*] Fixed bug that made Splatterang deal a crazy amount of damage
[*] Fixed bug that game permanently could break if you remapped controls in certain ways (this fix needed all saved remappings to be reset, sorry about that)
[/list]

What’s happening next? I am eagerly looking forward to the Steam Next Fest where I can hopefully get even more player feedback, and get ready for the final release. Im aiming for a Fall 2023 release at the moment, but let's see how that goes...

notes.title: April 2023 Update
notes.content:
Main update of this month is that I just released a new, big update for the demo. Please check it out and let me know what you think. Those familiar with the previous version will hopefully see some nice upgrades. 
[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[b]New upgrade choices
[/b]Before you were presented with 3 options. Reward 1, Reward 2 or a Random Reward. I felt like something was missing, and the random reward felt… unpredictable and not really fun. I changed that so that now you will instead get 3 reward options right away. If you like none of them, you can instead get 50 coins to save for another time. If you already have some coins, you can spend 25 coins to reroll your 3 rewards to something else. The goal is to make the choices you make a bit more informed, while still allowing some influence of luck if you want to risk it. Let me know if you like the new version or the old one best.

[b]New gem boxes[/b]
Before you got to choose between a standard reward or a random selection. Since the choice you were presented with didn't really help you make an informed choice, I removed it altogether. Instead I spiced up the reward box opening and split it in 3 tiers, and I think the end result is much nicer.

[b]Better controller support[/b]
I have changed the input prompts to better work with controllers, so hopefully you will have a better experience using those now. I also added a title screen where I can check the users first button input and change your settings to either mouse or controller based on that. The title screen also helped improve performance when loading in the game since I can redirect you to the right area directly after that.

One thing to note is that I have been working on fixing some stuff in the save system, so your previous demo save (if you had any) will be reset. Sorry about that. As always, if you got any feedback, please share it either here in the steam forum or on youtube or any other place, I’m reading or watching almost all of it. Every bit of feedback helps!

[h2]Other news
[/h2]Some other things I have worked on is of course polishing the game. I have quite a list of little bugs and  quirks I want to fix and improvements I want to add, so the more of that I have time to add before Steam Next Fest the better. Im also recording and editing a new trailer for that, which is a lot of fun but also takes soooo much time. Hopefully that will be live on my steam page very, very soon, and the you have to let me know what you think

notes.title: March 2023 Update
notes.content:
Bad news: I’ve been on vacation and made slower than normal progress this month. Good news: The game is almost finished. So where are we at with it and when can you play the full thing?

[h2]What is done?[/h2]
[list]
[*] The last boss, Princess Polka Dot, is done. A karate chopping lady bug high up in the treetops. Think she might be my most challenging but also favorite boss so far. What do you think of the name? Any other ideas?
[*] End credit scene: I wanted it to be satisfying for those of you who manage to reach the end so I have spent some time making a fun little cutscene for you all. I like it, so I hope you will too.
[*] Treetops content: I have been adding content in the form of fun rooms and more enemy types. Think this area is shaping up
[*] Bugs: I am playtasting like crazy and am still finding stuff, doing my best to fix it all before the launch.
[/list]

[h2]What is not done?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Before launch I have a couple of areas and bosses I want to polish up. I also plan to make sure to balance it as well as I can.
[*] Steam achievements. Not critical but I really want to have some, so working on adding a few ones.
[*] More upgrades and items. My idea list is still quite long and I have a couple I want to add for launch. I will have to draw the line somewhere and add the rest as future DLC, but a few more I think I can add.
[*] Testing… mentioned it above, but really want to have a smooth launch, so won’t try to rush it.
[/list]

I have also signed up for Steam Next Fest in June, so I plan to release an improved version of the demo for that, and also prepare a stream where I play the full version of the game. Really excited about that.

notes.title: February 2023 Update
notes.content:
Hey! Since the last update I have been working hard polishing and refining the game to make everything that happen after escaping the lawn much better. But since you won't be able to see that in the demo (yet), here comes a list of the improvements you CAN see:

[h2]New Weapons[/h2]
I will admit, I might have started to go a bit crazy
[list]
[*] Freeze Ray - Lock slime in place so no scary bug can try to claim it later on. Frozen slime is forever yours. Great to combine with other weapons
[*] Machine Slime - Shoot three bullets in rapid succession to scare away even the bravest of bugs
[*] Splatterang - Throw a splatterang out in the wild and wait for it to return to you. Hard to master, but really powerful if you manage to reposition yourself fast
[*] Flying Star - To be honest, I don't know what the hell this is, I just had lots of fun with it after accidentally creating it
[*] Other Upgrades - Be able to have multiple primaries, reload weapons even when not on your turf, instant reloads, and new unique upgrades for a lot of the existing weapons.[/list]

[h2]Other things[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed so many bugs that my head starts spinning... and I'm sure there is more, so keep reporting them. Splatting bugs has become my specialty now
[*] Added some new cool enemy types in the later areas... you dont want to face of against a Laser Wallflower or an Exploding Woodlouse
[*] Added more variation to the procedurally generated rooms
[/list]

There is so much I want to add but I will try to keep next month super-focused to get the later areas closer to a finished state. No new weapons... or at least I'll try

notes.title: January 2023 Update
notes.content:
Hey! Since releasing the demo I've gotten some great feedback from so many of you, and I have really been enjoying watching you spreading your turfs. I've gotten a much better sense of what works and in which areas the game can be improved. And I have been working hard making the game a lot better. So here is the release notes for the latest version of the demo:

[h2]Balancing changes[/h2]
Main goal is to make the gameplay a bit faster and rewarding aggressive play-styles more
[list]
[*] Upped the aggression of many enemies by having them fly towards the player and attack
[*] Reduced cooldown of all primary weapons
[*] Increased the bullet speed of all shooting abilities and increased length of Frog Tongue and Splat Blade
[*] Reduced prize of in-run upgrades and unlocking of new starting weapons to allow for more experimentation
[*] Reduced speed boost effect of green slime (to not having your snail go complexity insane combining it with other abilities)
[/list]
[h2]Quality of life & improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an indicator on the gun when the primary weapon reloads
[*] Added confirmation messages if trying to dismiss rewards
[*] Added new upgrade type Indestructible Bullets (that can be combined with all other upgrades)
[*] Added more variation in room layouts
[/list]
[h2]Bugs (not the enemy type)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the button indicators to display correctectly no matter if you use controller or keyboard (based on your last input)
[*] Removed button remapping from the home base area due some errors reported (option still available from settings menu)
[*] Fixed in-run shop not working correct in some cases
[/list]
At the same time I’m working on finishing one of the last areas of the game…The Treetops, featuring 8 new enemies, a new slime type, unique mechanics and obstacles and a nasty boss to finish it off. More will be revealed later, I promise

notes.title: Demo is here! Time to join the Turf Wars
notes.content:
[h2]What does the demo contain?[/h2]
The demo contains just the beginning of our snails garden escape, the journey across the lawn to the Green City. 

[b]Zones[/b]
[list]
[*]Start area
[*]Tutorial
[*]World 1 - The Lawn
[*]First city
[/list]
[b]Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*]4 different starting weapons to choose from
[*]16 unlockable weapons
[*]Over 100 upgrades (randomly generated inbetween areas)
[/list]
[h2]How can I give feedback?[/h2]
All feedback, good or bad or anything inbetween, can be shared in our discussion boards: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2058360/discussions/. We will read through everything and we really appreciate all help making the game even better

[i]Note that the demo contains an Alpha build of the game, and many parts could still change for the final version[/i]

[h2]I like the demo, when can I play the final version?[/h2]
We are still working on finishing the last areas, adding more weapons and creating an overall better experience. The planned release date is yet to be announced, but add it to your wishlist and you will be notified when we announce more info. 

Hope you enjoy it!
